place: Bang Po, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Hillside Sea-View Pool Villa in Bang Po
blurb: A hillside three-bedroom villa above Bang Po on Koh Samui's north coast, built around a private infinity pool and a 180-degree sweep of sea toward Koh Phangan — bright, earthy interiors with a fully equipped kitchen, an outdoor terrace and Bang Po beach just minutes away.
detail:
Set on a wooded hillside above Bang Po, this single-level villa is arranged to face the water. Glass sliding doors open the living room, dining area and every bedroom onto a timber deck, a lawn and a private infinity pool, with the sea and the island of Koh Phangan filling the horizon — a view that holds from almost every room and, by most accounts, looks better in person than in photographs.

Inside, soft sand-toned walls, rattan lighting, natural fibres and warm timber give the villa a relaxed, bohemian character. The open living space combines a deep sofa and television with a long dining table and a fully equipped kitchen — dishwasher, oven, gas hob, Nespresso machine — with a separate laundry holding a washer, dryer and iron. Three air-conditioned bedrooms take king or queen beds with wardrobes and safes, each with its own bathroom, several with a rain shower and a sea outlook, sleeping six.

Outside, a covered terrace, outdoor seating and a hammock chair surround the pool, with private parking at the door. Fibre Wi-Fi, a Smart TV and a Bluetooth speaker are included, along with twice-weekly housekeeping and pool and garden care. A guest manager can arrange airport transfers, car and scooter hire, a private chef or in-villa massage, and food delivery is available. The beach, restaurants and a mini market are about five minutes by car, so a vehicle is recommended; the airport is roughly 19 km away. Electricity is billed by meter, and the villa is not suited to parties or pets.
